Quick technical note and suggested fallback plan.

Notes: Priya's live demo uses a heavy sequence with long context; to minimize runtime risk we should:
- Pre-warm model cache with a short synthetic prompt 10 minutes before the demo.
- Keep a quantized model variant ready as an emergency (lower fidelity but stable).
- Prepare a screenshot walkthrough and a 2:40 pre-recorded clip (Priya said she has one).

Escalation flow (engineering ops):
1) AV vendor flags degradation -> message on #redwood-events (tagged @oncall-eng).
2) If model errors persist for >90s, host drops to pre-record and panel continues Q&A.
3) Aditya to open a support ticket with model runtime logs post-event for RCA.

I can draft the short pre-warm script and the commands to run the quantized fallback. Will post to the shared doc by EOD Dec 1.
